### bash

1,677 chars: description 564, parameter schema 1,067.

```text
Run a command in the working directory. Foreground calls return combined output. Background calls return a job id, pid and log path; completion arrives as a message. Use background: true for builds, full test suites, servers and anything over a minute; a foreground call moves to the background after 90s or on a user message. To wait in the foreground instead, set background: false with a timeout; the command is then stopped at the timeout. Never sleep-poll for jobs or files. A timeout does not undo side effects: inspect the result before rerunning a command.
```

    "reason"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",

        "bash",
        "powershell"
      ],
      "description": "bash (default, configured shell) or powershell (Windows)"
    },
    "command": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Command in the selected syntax"
    },
    "timeout": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Seconds before the command is stopped: foreground default 900s, at most 3600s. Separately, a foreground call still running after 90s moves to the background unless background is false. A background job has none unless given"
    },
    "maxOutputTokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Output token budget for this result (about 4 bytes each, at least 100)"
    },
    "background": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "true: return at once with a job id; false with a timeout: wait in the foreground and stop at the timeout"
    },
    "verify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Record a verification receipt tied to the current edits; a later edit makes it stale, and a zero exit proves only that the command succeeded."
    },
    "reason": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Why this call, one sentence"
    }
  }
}

### file

1,906 chars: description 508, parameter schema 1,352.

```text
Applies a batch of file changes; it does not read files. Pass queries (one object per change: type, path, edits or content) or a Codex-style patch string, not both; put a file's replacements in one query. Queries continue after a failed item; a patch validates everything first and stops at the first failure; neither rolls back. Read an existing file before changing it; edits need exact text matching once (or replaceAll), and writes/deletes refuse stale content. Paths outside the workspace need approval.
```

### web

1,080 chars: description 443, parameter schema 592.

```text
Pass query to search the web or url to read one http(s) page; supply exactly one. Fetches extract static page text and metadata or format JSON; they do not run JavaScript. A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP URL returns the image itself (resized when large; the original is saved and named); SVG is read as its XML source. Cross-host redirects name the next URL instead of following it. Successful page fetches are cached for 15 minutes (images are not).
```

    },
    "reason": {

      "description": "Why this call, one sentence"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "reason"
  ]
}

### mcp

1,703 chars: description 551, parameter schema 1,107.

```text
Manage this session's MCP servers. list or status: state, tool count and last error. tools: inspect the current catalog; name a tool for its full description, input/output schemas, without running it. connect or restart: start a stopped or failed server, or reconnect one that lost its connection (a restart within 10s of the previous one is refused). stop: end a server for this session, including default servers. add: run a new server for this session (the user confirms). remove: drop a server this tool added. Configuration files are not changed.
```

### debug

2,259 chars: description 559, parameter schema 1,653.

```text
Source-level debugger over DAP: line breakpoints, exception stops and stepping; no attach, evaluation or conditional breakpoints. launch without adapter returns the adapter recipes (lldb-dap, debugpy, js-debug) and runs nothing; launch with one runs the program (needs permission). Actions that run the program wait up to 30s, then return state, generation, frame and output. At a stop, pass the latest generation to scopes with frame.id, then variables; a resume replaces them. While running, call output again, pause or terminate; after ended, launch again.
```
